messages:
cooper: FYI - got a customer report: onboarding sample app double-submits when a 429 hits right as token refresh finishes. small window but nasty for payments.
linh: ouch. any logs? my guess: immediate replay with no idempotency key + zero jitter.
ivy: that's what happened during our internal replay stress test last week. we saw duplicate creates ~30-80ms apart.
cooper: paste from their sanitized logs:
```
[2026-03-22T11:05:12Z] auth: refresh_start
[2026-03-22T11:05:12Z] api: 429 rate_limit route=/v1/charge
[2026-03-22T11:05:12Z] auth: refresh_done
[2026-03-22T11:05:12Z] client: replaying original request (no idempotency)
[2026-03-22T11:05:12Z] api: charge created id=ch_01
[2026-03-22T11:05:12Z] api: charge created id=ch_02
```
linh: ok. proposed fixes: 1) update sample app to always set Idempotency-Key for non-idempotent endpoints; 2) add a small randomized sleep before replaying after auth refresh; 3) SDK-level optional middleware `replay_guard` that can block/reject non-idempotent replays unless Idempotency-Key present.
ivy: I like the middleware. default should be permissive for backwards compat, but offer `replay_guard: {mode: 'warn'|'block'|'auto-key'}`. auto-key could auto-insert a UUID if callsite opts-in.
cooper: server-side dedupe is also a possibility but not reliable across all services. infra can try a short lived dedupe (200-300ms) for critical endpoints.
linh: small jitter range I tested: 20-200ms works well; keep it configurable per-SDK. also add a structured log field `replay_suspect=true` and telemetry metric `replays_after_refresh`.
ivy: sample snippet for docs: 
```
// client wrapper
if (authRefreshed()) {
  await sleep(randomInt(20,200)); // jitter to avoid double writes
}
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = headers['Idempotency-Key'] || generateUUID();
```
Add an explanation: "Prefer server-supported idempotency for unambiguous de-duplication; jitter reduces collision probability when server dedupe not available."
cooper: QA: I'll add a test `onboarding_refresh_race_361850` in the sampleapp suite that simulates 429+refresh race and asserts only one side-effect.
bot-deploy: Created ticket DEVEX-36185 "onboarding: mitigate dup side-effects on auth refresh races" and added to backlog.
linh: SDK PR plan: 1) implement replay_guard middleware + config, 2) add jittered-replay helper used only on refresh path, 3) telemetry tags and log fields. will mark default mode as 'warn' for minor SDK release.
ivy: Docs: add "When you see duplicate resources after retries" section in onboarding guide. include pattern for idempotency header and note about streaming vs non-streaming endpoints (streaming ops might need different handling).
cooper: timeline: sampleapp & docs this week, SDK guard + tests next week, infra dedupe evaluation by infra team.
linh: one more ask: instrument SDK to surface a count in console logs when replay_guard blocks a replay so developers can spot it during onboarding.
ivy: agreed. no objections. :thumbsup:
cooper: thanks team. I'll follow up with PR links.
